name: cdk
//brace-expansion-note: GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2 affects brace-expansion 5.0.2-5.0.5. npm auto-resolves the non-bundled copies (vitest -> minimatch -> brace-expansion) to >=5.0.6 already; no override needed. The only stuck copy is the one bundled inside aws-cdk-lib's published tarball, which npm overrides can't reach. That instance isn't exploitable because CDK only feeds it file paths we control during synth, never untrusted input. The Dependabot alert (#146) for the bundled copy is dismissed as tolerable_risk; it will clear when aws-cdk-lib bundles a patched brace-expansion. A blanket override here breaks minimatch@9.0.9 (nested under glob) which expects the brace-expansion 2.x default-export API.
